fee_notes: Royalty: 7% of GPS Revenue, waived first 12 months for new franchisees; minimum royalty $0 (months 1-12), $800 (months 13-24), $1,000 (months 25+). MDF: 1.5% of GPS Revenue with minimum contribution. Local marketing: $2,500/month mandatory. Tech: $200/month base + software subscriptions (Autotask, Office 365, QuickBooks). Additional fees: training, convention, transfer, renewal, insurance, audit, etc.
